DIALOGUE.level: -inf (track exists but is empty - the film is wordless)

MUSIC.note: never competes with the gait ticks; ducks 3 dB under IGNITION_BLOOM

SFX.note: the gait ticks are the lead voice of the film - always intelligible over ambience

AMBIENCE.note: ducks 4 dB for 12 frames under dialogue-grade SFX (clicks, ignition)

measurement.method: pyloudnorm (ITU-R BS.1770-4) integrated loudness; true peak 4x oversampled (tools/lufs.py); mix built in numpy from AUDIO_TIMELINE events + gains + fades + MIX_PLAN stem trims
measurement.note: trim to be applied at T12 final mix; peak ceiling respected
